thread:
Emma: Short RFC follow-up: propose an ingress 'compat facade' that accepts legacy payloads and emits the new runtime surface. Opt-in flag per-tenant, header-gated. Key idea: lightweight hand-off token so runtime can skip normalization if facade already did it.
Leo: Hand-off token sounds good. How do we represent it? X-Compat-Token with a small manifest (version, mapping-hash, strict|best-effort). Runtime can verify mapping-hash to skip work.
Harper: Perf note: facade can be Envoy WASM or a native filter. WASM looked ~1ms median on our bench and ~6ms p99 for streaming frames. Need a CPU circuit-breaker so we don't overload gateways under heavy streams.
Emma: Agree on circuit-breaker. Also we must avoid double-serialization: runtime must check X-Compat-Token and short-circuit. If token missing runtime proceeds with its own compatibility layer.
Leo: Cache compatibility: if facade renames fields used in prefix/embedding cache keys we should emit X-Canonical-Key header computed from canonicalize(raw_input). That way cache layers remain stable. Monitor canonical_cache_miss_delta after rollout.
Harper: Tool arg aliasing: we should maintain an alias registry in the tool registry layer. Facade can apply harmless aliases but must never coerce types. Ambiguous renames produce a tombstone pointer: X-Orig-Tombstone: s3://... when tenant enables debug.
Emma: Security: no templating or eval in transforms. All mapping rules must be declarative and in a signed bundle with audit trail. sec-bot will run an automated audit on mapping bundles before they deploy.
sec-bot: Noted. Will run mapping audit and enforce redaction-first logging. Any mapping touching PII needs manual review. RBAC: only platform-release and tenant-ops can toggle the opt-in flag.
Leo: Rollout plan idea: internal dev tenants (4) -> early partners (12) -> 50 tenants -> broad. Canary gates: facade_error_rate, p99_latency_delta, canonical_cache_miss_delta, gateway_cpu_saturation.
Harper: Also add telemetry: facade_invoked, facade_duration_ms, facade_stream_reframes, facade_ambiguous_count. Tag by tenant_id, route, and compat_mode. Ensure request_id is threaded into logs.
infra-bot: Created alert "facade_error_rate" -> page if >1% over 5m for >=4 tenants. Dashboard panel "Compat Facade - invocations/latency/cpu" added.
Emma: Failure semantics: default best-effort = forward original with X-Compat-Warn header. Strict tenant mode = return 422 on ambiguous transforms. Also provide an opt-out TTL that auto-reverts the tenant flag after N days unless renewed.
Leo: Edge case: streaming delta semantics that can't be losslessly mapped. For those, send header X-Compat-Note: partial-mapped and include tombstone pointer when debug enabled.
Harper: I'll draft a compact WASM filter sketch + perf numbers and a circuit-breaker proposal (ETA 72h).
Emma: I'll own the mapping bundle spec, canonical key algorithm, and rollout cohorts (ETA 24h).
Leo: I'll coordinate RBAC, alias registry plan, and alert tuning (ETA 48h).
Emma: Thanks. Action items summarized and we'll reconvene once artifacts landed. :white_check_mark:
